findings.claim: The bounded related-function surface contains 75 functions: 10 cached, 4 context, 1 manifest and 4 receipt-named.
Exact raw-body and whitespace-normalized duplicate grouping both produce 2 groups containing 5 functions.
Among 16 manifest/receipt-related functions, volatility partitions into 1 immutable, 4 stable and 11 volatile; 9 are executable by current principal, including 5 volatile.
track_functions=none with zero function-stat rows/calls, so zero stats are non-informative about runtime use.
Frozen static graph has 38 callers and 76 declared edges, max out-degree 5 and no zero-callee caller.

invariants.statement: Existing evidence-related surfaces exist before proposing a new subsystem.
Whitespace normalization should not create spurious duplicate-body groups in this set.
invariants.observed: raw and normalized both 2 groups/5 functions

invariants.statement: EXECUTE privilege is not equivalent to read-only safety for volatile functions.
Zero pg_stat_user_functions rows cannot imply zero use when track_functions=none.
Static declared graph cannot establish runtime frequency/criticality.

metamorphic_tests.transform: Whitespace-normalize function bodies before duplicate grouping.
metamorphic_tests.expected_relation: If duplicates are formatting artifacts only, grouping changes.
metamorphic_tests.observed_relation: No change: 2 groups/5 functions both ways.

C.solver_reason: Catalog/count invariants directly testable in SQL.
overfitting_checks: Do not infer deletion safety from duplicate body equality.
Do not invoke volatile evidence functions merely because EXECUTE is granted.
Do not infer non-use from disabled statistics.

E.rationale: No runtime defect is demonstrated. Existing evidence surfaces and duplicate variants warrant verification/reuse before any new subsystem or deletion.
potential_falsifiers: Compatibility ownership proves one duplicate variant unsafe/obsolete.
Authorized safe manifest readback reveals material inconsistency.
Governed runtime telemetry contradicts static graph assumptions.

reversal_criteria.to_REPAIR_REQUIRED: A material current inconsistency or unsafe duplicate is proven.
reversal_criteria.to_VERIFY_FIRST: Existing safe evidence surfaces can close a bounded gap.

negative_falsifiers: Do not delete duplicate variants based on body equality alone.
Do not invoke volatile functions solely due EXECUTE.
Do not infer zero use from disabled stats.
Do not infer runtime criticality from static edges.
next_safe_step: Reuse authorized safe evidence surfaces first; no runtime subsystem or duplicate removal.
